title: The Thief's Apprentice
logline: A street thief accidentally steals highly sensitive extortion material and tries to sell it, putting everyone in danger.

roles.description: Overconfident, in way over their head, scared.
Cynical but possesses a buried moral compass.
A stealthy vessel belonging to a professional extortionist.
A bustling hub of independent journalists.

public_situation: A notorious blackmailer's secure data courier has been mugged in the docking bays.
private_truth: The thief didn't know what they were stealing, and now they are trying to ransom it back to the extortionist.

beats.public_change: The blackmailer puts out a quiet but massive reward for the thief.

missions.reason: Needs the data drive picked up from a dead drop and delivered to the reporter for appraisal.
missions.private_fact: The thief is currently hiding in a ventilation shaft and cannot move.

beats.public_change: The reporter realizes what the data is and panics.

missions.reason: Needs a secure comms buoy deployed to safely broadcast the extortion material before they are killed.
missions.private_fact: The reporter is sacrificing their career by breaking an embargo to do this.

beats.public_change: The blackmailer tracks the signal to the media station.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to intercept the blackmailer's ship and recover their master decryption key.
missions.private_fact: The key will not only unlock this data, but expose the blackmailer's entire network.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the decryption key and must decide its fate.

options.label: Give the key to the reporter to publish
Sell the key back to the blackmailer
Help the thief negotiate a payout

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot gives the key to the reporter.
resolutions.summary: The extortion network is exposed. The blackmailer is ruined, and the thief gets a clean slate.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons the mission or sells the key.
resolutions.summary: The blackmailer recovers the data. The young thief disappears without a trace.
The thief somehow negotiates a massive payout and vanishes, leaving the reporter empty-handed.

loose_threads.detail: The primary target of the extortion was a highly decorated local judge.
The reporter's encrypted tip-line is receiving automated pings from a supposed dead sector.

radio_hooks: Station security searches for suspected pickpocket.

voice_direction.young_thief: High-pitched, trying to sound tough, voice cracking.
voice_direction.jaded_reporter: Gravelly, talks around the cigar in their mouth, world-weary.
